Md. Akkas Ali

The Government of Bangladesh and Others
full_judgment: 3. The petitioner is a conscious and public spirited citizen of Bangladesh. He was elected Chairman of the Biaghat Union Parishad thrice previously. At present he is the officiating Chairman of the said Union Parishad. However, the Biaghat Union Parishad 'Bhaban was constructed at Mouza Jogandronagar on the bank of the river Atrai in 1952. Since the Union Parishad building is dilapidated, it has not been used for a pretty long time. Furthermore, the Parishad Building goes under water during rainy season almost every year. The land on which the Parishad Building is situated has been threatened by river erosion. The Biaghat Union Parishad Complex was in the middle of the Biaghat Union when the present Khubjipur Union was under the Biaghat Union. As the present site of the present Biaghat Union Parishad Complex has become unfit for carrying on official functions, a suitable site for the new Complex Building has been found to be a necessity. The procedure and conditions for site selection for constructing a new Union Parishad Complex Building have been mentioned in the ‘পরিপত্র’ dated 28.12.2005 published by the respondent no. 1. As per the conditions embodied in the said `পরিপত্র', the new Union Parishad Complex Bhaban may be constructed at Biaghat Bazar as it is ideally suited therefor. In that regard, a resolution was taken by the Biaghat Union Parishad on 28.09.2008. Anyway, the Upazilla Nirbahi Officer of Gurudaspur made an inquiry into the matter and submitted his report on 17.11.2008. Subsequently, the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Natore made a spot inquiry and submitted his report on 04.12.2008 stating that Jogandronagar is suitable for construction of the new Union Parishad Complex. In due course, by a Memo dated 29.03.2009, the Deputy Commissioner of Natore (respondent no.5) informed the Government that the approved site at Mouza Jogandronagar under Khatian No. 2 (Dag Nos. 2220 and 2221) is suitable for construction of a new Union Parishad Complex. Thereafter on 13.04.2009, the petitioner filed an application to the respondent no. 1 stating, inter ilia, that the approved site at Jogandronagar was in the middle of the erstwhile Biaghat Union and the Government split the former Union into two Unions, namely, Biaghat and Khubjipur and the proposed place at Jogandronagar stands in one corner of Biaghat Union and adjacent to new Khubjipur Union and that being so, the impugned approval accorded by the respondent no.1 for construction of the new Union Parishad Complex at Jogandronagar is not in keeping with the 'পরিপত্র' dated 28.12.2005 (Annexure-'A').
